---
title: "Quarto Documentation"
subtitle: "A Single File Template for Quarto Documentation"
date: last-modified
# date: 03/07/2025
date-format: long # full, long, medium, short, iso
number-sections: false
highlight-style: pygments
abstract: 
  This is a template for Quarto presentation. 
  It includes basic elements like bullet points, equations, citations, and code blocks.
  You can also use it to generate PowerPoint and PDF documents.
bibliography: assets/references.bib
format: 

  html:
    author: "Siyuan Wang¹"
    institute: "Sothern University of Science and Technology¹"
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    toc-title: Contents
    code-fold: true
    html-math-method: katex
    # theme: assets/custom.scss
    theme:
      light: assets/custom.scss
      dark: assets/custom_dark.scss
    # theme: lux # default, pandoc, cosmo, spacelab, lux, minty, flatly, darkly
    # for more themes: https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html
    # theme: # switch light and dark theme
    #   light: flatly
    #   dark: darkly
    max-width: 1500px
    fontsize: 20px
    # fontcolor: "#374151"

  pdf:
    author: 
        - name: "Siyuan Wang¹"
          affiliation: 
            - name: "Sothern University of Science and Technology¹"
            - department: "Department of Mechanical and Energy Engineering"   
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    toc-title: Contents
    template-partials:
        - ./assets/before-body.tex
    number-sections: true
    documentclass: article # article, report
    # classoption: [twocolumn, landscape]
    mainfont: "Latin Modern Sans"
    # mainfont: "Noto Serif CJK SC"
    # mainfont: Times New Roman
    # CJKmainfont: "Noto Serif CJK SC"
    colorlinks: true
    geometry:
      - top=20mm
      - left=30mm
      - right=30mm
      - heightrounded
    # hyperlink
    links-as-notes: true
    reference-location: section # block, section, margin, document # if show hyperlink in the footnote
    # Citation
    link-bibliography: true
    link-citations: true
    # Misc
    lof: false # Print a list of figures in the doc
    lot: false # Print a list of tables in the doc
    include-in-header: # Use normalsize font for abstract contents
      text: |
        \usepackage{etoolbox}
        \makeatletter
        \patchcmd{\abstract}{\small}{\normalsize}{}{}
        \makeatother
---

# Basic Elements 基本的使用

## Heading 2 二级标题
Contents: blablabla

### Heading 3 三级标题
Contents: blablabla

<br>

## Bullet Points

> hello world

- apple
  - banana
    - orange


## Pics & Videos & HTML

- Add a picture

This is [@fig-xinbaodao]

![XinBaoDao Dance](./assets/xinbaodao.png){#fig-xinbaodao fig-align="center" width="400px"}

<br>

- Embed a video

{{< video ./assets/xinbaodao.mp4 >}}

<br>

- Embed a HTML

```{=html}
<iframe width="880" height="500" src="https://quarto.org/docs/presentations/revealjs/demo/" title="Quarto Documentation"></iframe>
```

```{=html}
<iframe width="880" height="700" src="https://www.trex-game.skipser.com/" ></iframe>
```

<br>

## Equations, Citations


- Einstein's theory of special relatively that expresses the equivalence of mass and energy:

    $E = mc^{2}$

- Input an inline equation: $\mathbb {E}(x) = \int xf(x)dx$


- Cite a reference like [@peng_amp_2021].

<br>

## Codeblock 


```{python}
print("hello world")
print("This is a python code block")
```
